requirements.name: NCAGE code
requirements.summary: A five-character entity identifier from the NATO codification system. Needed for NATO and NSPA supply and for stock numbers. Free of charge.
requirements.description:
The NATO Commercial and Government Entity (NCAGE) code is a five-character entity identifier. It is required for NATO Stock Number (NSN) assignment, for registration in NATO and national supply systems, and for procurement through NSPA. Holding an NCAGE code does not give any right to use NATO branding.

Who handles the request depends on the country. For NATO countries and a defined Tier 2 list, the request is handled by the national codification bureau (NCB); for everyone else NSPA handles it directly. The Tier 2 list includes Ukraine, alongside ARE, ARG, AUS, AUT, BRA, COL, GEO, IND, IDN, ISR, JOR, JPN, KOR, MYS, MAR, NZL, SRB, SGP and QAT.

The request starts in the NCAGE request tool: three mandatory fields on the first step (type of entity, other/priority, country), then a validation link is sent to the person who started it. Once validated, the priority cannot be changed.

days.text: Up to 14 working days on average; routine priority is 10 calendar days, emergency is 3 working days
days.note: Working days are converted to calendar days at 7/5 and rounded up: 3 working days is 5 calendar days and 14 working days is 20.

requirements.mandatory_for: NATO and NSPA supply; NATO Stock Number assignment. Not an eligibility condition of EDF, EDIP or SAFE.

requirements.name: PIC (Participant Identification Code)
requirements.summary: A nine-digit code issued when an organisation registers on the EU Funding and Tenders Portal. Free and immediate. Needed to apply for EDF and EDIP funding.
requirements.description:
Register the organisation on the Funding and Tenders Portal through a six-step wizard. A nine-digit PIC is issued immediately when the wizard is complete. An EU Login account is needed. Incomplete drafts are deleted after one year.

Validation by the Central Validation Service (legal entity form, a recent VAT extract, a registration extract or the statutes) is required only if a proposal is selected for funding; for many grants REA performs it. A Legal Entity Appointed Representative (LEAR) must be appointed to update the organisation's data and to handle electronic signatures. A financial capacity assessment applies to grants, except for public bodies and certain other cases.

requirements.name: SAFE origin rule (Article 16)
requirements.summary: In a SAFE-supported procurement, components from outside the Union, the EEA EFTA states and Ukraine may not cost more than 35 % of the estimated cost of the components of the end product, and no component may come from a third country that contravenes the Union's security and defence interests.
requirements.description:
The 35 % is measured against the estimated cost of the components of the end product. It is not measured against the contract value; briefings often paraphrase it wrongly as a share of contract value. There is also a separate, absolute prohibition: no component at all may be sourced from a third country that contravenes the security and defence interests of the Union and its Member States. The percentage allowance does not cover it.

The same Article also sets rules on establishment, executive management and control for contractors and subcontractors; they are listed on the SAFE card of the readiness page.

requirements.name: ISO 9001 quality management certificate
requirements.summary: The general quality management standard. AQAP 2110 contains all of ISO 9001:2015, so holding it makes the AQAP path shorter and cheaper.
requirements.description:
AQAP 2110 contains the whole of ISO 9001:2015 plus NATO-specific additions. In practice: build ISO 9001 first, then add the NATO layer. Companies that already hold ISO 9001 face a materially shorter and cheaper path to AQAP 2110.

requirements.name: AQAP 2110 quality assurance certification
requirements.summary: NATO quality assurance requirements for design, development and production. Not an eligibility condition of EDF, EDIP or SAFE: it enters through individual contracts and cascades down the supply chain.
requirements.description:
AQAP 2110 Edition D Version 1 was promulgated by the NATO Standardization Office on 24 June 2016 and is still in force in 2026. AQAP 2210 (software quality requirements) is layered on AQAP 2110 or 2310 and is not standalone. AQAP 2120 no longer exists separately: it was folded into AQAP 2110 when Edition D was issued in 2016, so anyone still asking for AQAP 2120 is working from stale guidance.

Do you need it for EDF? Not to apply, but likely to deliver. No blanket AQAP requirement appears in the EDF, EDIP or SAFE regulations as an eligibility condition (those regulate control, establishment and component origin). It enters when a prime contractor or a national buyer names it in a contract, and it then cascades down to subcontractors.

Issued by national defence authorities (Government Quality Assurance) or by accredited certification bodies, depending on the country. Certificates run for three years with annual surveillance audits.

requirements.name: Export authorisation for dual-use or military items
requirements.summary: An authorisation to export items in a controlled category. Which licence depends on whether the item is in the dual-use regime or the military regime.
requirements.description:
Two regimes are frequently confused. Dual-use items fall under Regulation (EU) 2021/821, whose Annex I is the control list. Military goods fall under the Common Military List, with transfers inside the EU governed by Directive 2009/43/EC and separate licences. A product can be in the military regime and not the dual-use one, so the first question is which regime applies.

The exporter is responsible for deciding whether its product matches an Annex I entry. Customs and tariff codes only signal that control is possible; they do not settle it. The basis is the manufacturer's datasheet and, where uncertain, a formal classification request to the competent authority.

This service asks which regime applies to your product and names the competent authority for the countries where we collected it (Spain, Germany and Poland). It does not tell you whether a given category needs a licence, it does not publish control list parameters or technical thresholds, and it gives no advice on controlled items.

requirements.mandatory_for: Export of items in controlled categories.

requirements.name: HSEM facility security clearance (Spain)
requirements.summary: The Spanish company security clearance (Habilitación de Seguridad de Empresa), needed by bidders and subcontractors at any level that access classified information. Who issues it depends on whose information it is. How long it takes is not published.
requirements.description:
Who processes the HSEM depends on who owns the classified information. For Ministry of Defence classified contracts the Dirección General de Armamento y Material (DGAM) runs the procedures to obtain, upgrade, suspend or withdraw the HSEM and the HSES (Resolución 320/14546/2013, which implements Instrucción 52/2013). For classified information of NATO, the EU and ESA the authority is the Oficina Nacional de Seguridad (ONS), under the Secretaria de Estado Directora del CNI.

A contracting body must require the clearance of bidders and of every subcontractor, at any level of the chain, that will access classified information (Ley 24/2011, art. 21.2).

Related clearances: HSES (Habilitación de Seguridad de Establecimiento) is needed on top of the HSEM if classified information is stored on your own premises; HPS (Habilitación Personal de Seguridad) is the individual clearance.

How long an HSEM takes and what it costs were not published. Other countries have their own National Security Authority; the research behind this page has collected Spain and Germany only.
requirements.mandatory_for: Accessing classified information, as a bidder or as a subcontractor at any level (Spain).
requirements.source_ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Seguridad de la información en las empresas (SEGINFOEMP); CNI, Oficina Nacional de Seguridad

passages.text: Obtención, modificación del grado, suspensión o retirada de la Habilitación de Seguridad de Empresa (HSEM) y, en su caso, la Habilitación de Seguridad de Establecimiento (HSES) necesarias para que las empresas puedan participar en los contratos en los que se maneje información clasificada.

Creada en 1983, la ONS tiene la misión de proteger la información clasificada mediante la habilitación de personas, empresas y organismos y la acreditación de sistemas TIC en los que se maneja dicha información.

requirements.name: PECAL certification (Spain, DGAM)
requirements.summary: The Spanish state certification of a quality management system against PECAL 2110 or 2310 (the Spanish editions of AQAP). It needs the RID and ISO 9001 or EN 9100 first, and the initial audit expects prior PECAL contract experience.
requirements.description:
The PECAL are the Spanish quality publications based on NATO's AQAP. A contract that names one must be met whether or not the supplier holds the certificate, under the oversight of a DGAM quality representative (RAC); the certificate itself is granted by the DGAM after an initial audit, and renewal and surveillance audits are done by certification bodies recognised by the CMDIN.

To apply, the company must hold a current registration with the DGAM (the RID) and a third-party ISO 9001 certificate from an ENAC-accredited body (EN 9100 for PECAL 2310), with a scope no narrower than the PECAL request; PECAL lapses if that certificate lapses.

The DGAM issues a quote for the fee. UNVERIFIED: no fee amount, processing time or validity period is published.

extras.question: Does the company hold a PECAL certificate (PECAL 2110 or 2310)?
extras.roadmap_note: The chicken-and-egg of PECAL: the DGAM's initial audit expects a PECAL system audited by your management for at least nine months and at least one Ministry of Defence contract with PECAL requirements in the last two years (or a certificate of conformity signed by a DGAM quality representative). A newcomer therefore usually meets PECAL inside a first contract, under the quality representative's oversight, and applies for the certificate afterwards. It is not a block before a first contract: get the RID and ISO 9001 (or EN 9100) first.

requirements.mandatory_for: Ministry of Defence contracts that name a PECAL; the certificate itself is optional.

This figure is a share of the contract value. It is not the 35 % component cost threshold above.

a direct contractual relationship related to the defence product has been established between the contractor and that subcontractor prior to the date of entry into force of this Regulation;

rules.title: Components from outside the Union and associated countries: at most 35 % of component cost

rules.title: Subcontractors outside the Union: the 15 to 35 % allowance

texts.info: Common procurement under the Programme can include a subcontractor that is allocated between 15 % and 35 % of the value of the contract and is not established, or has no executive management structures, in the Union or an associated country, if a direct contractual relationship related to the defence product was established between the contractor and that subcontractor before the Regulation entered into force (it was published on 29 December 2025 and entered into force on the following day). This figure is a share of the contract value. It is not the 35 % component cost limit.

rules.note: A 'subcontractor' in the sense of this Regulation is narrower than any supplier: the definition in Article 2 requires at least 15 % of the value of the contract and a need for access to classified information, and leaves out suppliers that deliver components of their own design or production.

passages.text: By way of derogation from paragraph 6, in order to take into account industrial cooperation with non-associated third countries, common procurement that involves a subcontractor that is allocated between 15 % and 35 % of the value of the contract, and that is not established or does not have its executive management structures in the Union or in an associated country, shall be eligible for support under the Programme provided that a direct contractual relationship related to the defence product has been established between the contractor and that subcontractor prior to the date of entry into force of this Regulation.

‘subcontractor’ means an economic operator that is proposed by a candidate, tenderer or contractor to perform specific tasks or services under the supervision of the main contractor, contributing to the design or manufacturing of a defence product, other than what is provided by suppliers to implement the contract, for which it is allocated at least 15 % of the value of the contract, and that needs access to classified information for the performance of that contract; for the purposes of this definition, ‘supplier’ shall be understood as an economic operator that delivers components of its own design or production to the contractor.

rules.title: Registration in the defence industry register (RID)

texts.requires: A Spanish company needs a current certificate of registration, or of renewal, in the Registro de la Industria de Defensa (RID) to be in the Ministry of Defence's catalogue of actual or potential suppliers, and for other Ministry procedures such as PECAL certification and the NATO Declaration of Eligibility.
texts.met: You hold a current RID certificate.
texts.not_met: You need a current RID certificate to be in the Ministry of Defence's catalogue of actual or potential suppliers, and for PECAL certification and the NATO Declaration of Eligibility. It is requested online from the DIGEID, with the company's electronic certificate.
texts.unknown: The questionnaire does not ask yet whether you hold a current RID certificate. If you do not, it is the first thing to obtain: it is in your roadmap, and you can mark it as done there if you already hold it.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns companies established in Spain.

rules.note: UNVERIFIED: the legal basis of the register, its fee, processing time and validity were not found in a primary source, so none is shown.
rules.source_ref: Ministerio de Defensa, e-office procedure “Registro de la Industria de Defensa - RID” (SIA 993054)

passages.ref: Ministerio de Defensa, e-office procedure list, RID (SIA 993054)
passages.text: TRAMITACIÓN DEL CERTIFICADO DE INSCRIPCIÓN O RENOVACIÓN DEL CERTIFICADO EN EL REGISTRO DE LA INDUSTRIA DE DEFENSA (RID) DE LA DIRECCIÓN GENERAL DE ESTRATEGIA E INNOVACIÓN DE LA INDUSTRIA DE DEFENSA (DIGEID), REQUISITO NECESARIO PARA FORMAR PARTE DEL CATÁLOGO DE PROVEEDORES REALES O POTENCIALES DEL MINISTERIO DE DEFENSA, ASÍ COMO OTROS PROCEDIMIENTOS DEL MINISTERIO DE DEFENSA.

rules.title: PECAL quality requirements come with the contract

texts.info: The PECAL (Spanish quality publications based on NATO's AQAP) are requirements only of the defence contracts that include them. When a contract names one, you must meet it under the oversight of a DGAM quality representative (RAC). Read the technical (PPT) and administrative (PCAP) specifications of the contracts you target.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns companies established in Spain.
texts.consultant: Prime qualification: if you supply through a prime contractor and not the Ministry directly, the prime qualifies its suppliers by its own procedure, which none of the sources read here publishes. Ask the prime, or a consultant, what it requires.

rules.source_ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Aseguramiento de la calidad (PECAL)

passages.ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Aseguramiento de la calidad
passages.text: Las publicaciones españolas de calidad (PECAL), que están basadas en las correspondientes publicaciones AQAP de la OTAN, especifican los requisitos de la OTAN y del Ministerio de Defensa de España para la gestión de la calidad que deben cumplir los suministradores en los contratos de Defensa en los que se las incluye

rules.title: Quality clauses and the DGAM-endorsed certificate of conformity

texts.info: Ministry of Defence contracting bodies must put quality clauses in the technical (PPT) and administrative (PCAP) specifications, and a contract can be accepted only after the DGAM has endorsed the certificate of conformity of quality issued for it (Instrucción 39/1998, which implements O.M. 65/1993).
texts.not_applicable: This concerns companies established in Spain.

rules.source_ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Aseguramiento de la calidad (Instrucción 39/1998)

passages.ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Aseguramiento de la calidad
passages.text: [...] la inclusión de cláusulas de calidad en los Pliegos de Prescripciones Técnicas (PPT) y en los Pliegos de Cláusulas Administrativas Particulares (PCAP) y la obligatoriedad, para la recepción de un contrato, de que la DGAM haya refrendado previamente el correspondiente certificado de conformidad de calidad emitido para el mismo.

rules.title: PECAL certification of your quality management system (DGAM)

texts.requires: To apply for PECAL 2110 or 2310 certification a company must have a current registration with the DGAM (the RID) and a third-party ISO 9001 certificate from an ENAC-accredited body (EN 9100 for PECAL 2310). The DGAM's initial audit also expects a PECAL system in place for at least nine months and an MoD contract with PECAL requirements in the last two years, or a certificate of conformity signed by a DGAM quality representative.
texts.met: You hold PECAL, or you meet the conditions to apply for it.
texts.not_met: To apply for the PECAL certificate you first need a current RID registration and a third-party ISO 9001 certificate from an ENAC-accredited body (EN 9100 for PECAL 2310). See your roadmap.
texts.conditional: You hold the RID registration and ISO 9001 or EN 9100, but the DGAM's initial audit also expects a PECAL system audited by your management for at least nine months and at least one Ministry of Defence contract with PECAL requirements in the last two years (or a certificate of conformity signed by a DGAM quality representative). A newcomer usually meets PECAL inside a first contract, under the quality representative's oversight, before it can hold the certificate: this does not stop you from bidding.
texts.unknown: Answer the questions below to see whether you can apply for the PECAL certificate now.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns Spanish companies that want the PECAL certificate itself. PECAL inside a contract is the rule on contract requirements.

rules.note: Initial audit by the DGAM; renewal and surveillance audits by certification bodies recognised by the CMDIN. The DGAM issues a quote for the fee. UNVERIFIED: no fee amount, processing time or validity period is published.

passages.text: Para acceder a la certificación del sistema de gestión de la calidad según PECAL 2110, PECAL 2310, PECAL 2110/2310 y PECAL 2110 o 2310 con los requisitos PECAL 2210, es condición necesaria que la empresa tenga vigente: 1. Su inscripción en el Registro de empresas de la DGAM.
Al menos un contrato con el Ministerio de Defensa en los dos (2) últimos años con exigencia de cumplimiento de requisitos PECAL.

rules.title: ISO 9001 or EN 9100 as a formal precondition of PECAL

texts.requires: PECAL certification needs a current third-party ISO 9001 certificate from an ENAC-accredited body, with a scope no narrower than the PECAL request (EN 9100 for PECAL 2310). PECAL lapses if that certificate lapses.
texts.met: You hold ISO 9001 or EN 9100. Keep its scope no narrower than your PECAL request: PECAL lapses if it lapses.
texts.not_met: PECAL certification needs a current third-party ISO 9001 certificate from an ENAC-accredited body (EN 9100 for PECAL 2310), with a scope no narrower than the PECAL request.
texts.unknown: Say whether you want the PECAL certificate itself.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns Spanish companies that want the PECAL certificate itself.

passages.text: La certificación de sistemas de gestión de la calidad por tercera parte según UNE-EN-ISO 9001, emitida por una entidad de certificación acreditada por ENAC, y para un alcance de certificado no inferior al incluido en la solicitud de certificación PECAL (F4302.01).

rules.title: ISO 9001 as a filter

texts.info: ISO 9001 is a formal precondition on the Spanish state route (PECAL 2110, DGAM procedure PA 4302). For the general claim that defence buyers require ISO 9001, no primary source was found, so this service does not make it.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns companies established in Spain.

rules.note: UNVERIFIED: ISO 9001 or IATF 16949 as a general buyer filter outside the PECAL route.

passages.text: La certificación de sistemas de gestión de la calidad por tercera parte según UNE-EN-ISO 9001, emitida por una entidad de certificación acreditada por ENAC, y para un alcance de certificado no inferior al incluido en la solicitud de certificación PECAL (F4302.01).

rules.title: EN 9100 for PECAL 2310

texts.requires: PECAL 2310 (aviation, space and defence) contains all the quality requirements of UNE-EN 9100 plus NATO-specific requirements.
texts.met: You hold EN 9100.
texts.not_met: PECAL 2310 contains all the requirements of UNE-EN 9100: without EN 9100 you cannot meet it.
texts.unknown: Say whether you target PECAL 2310.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns Spanish companies that target PECAL 2310.

passages.text: La norma PECAL 2310 contiene todos los requisitos de calidad contenidos en la norma UNEEN 9100 junto con otros requisitos incluidos como Requisitos específicos OTAN”.

rules.title: AQAP editions as the Spanish Ministry of Defence lists them

texts.info: When a contract names an AQAP or a PECAL, check the edition. The Ministry of Defence lists: PECAL 2110 Ed. 4 = AQAP-2110 Ed. D V1; PECAL 2310 Ed. B V1 = AQAP-2310 Ed. B V1; PECAL 2131 Ed. 3 = AQAP-2131 Ed. C V1 (final inspection and test, relevant to build-to-print component makers). PECAL 2210 is a supplement to 2110 or 2310. The contractual AQAP/PECAL 2000 series is a civil standard such as ISO 9001 plus NATO-specific requirements.

rules.source_ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Aseguramiento de la calidad (list of PECAL and AQAP editions)

passages.ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Aseguramiento de la calidad
passages.text: Los requisitos de la serie de normas AQAP/PECAL 2000 contractuales son los requisitos de una norma civil (como por ejemplo, los de la ISO 9001) más una serie de requisitos específicos OTAN.

rules.title: NCAGE code (Spain)

texts.requires: In Spain a new NCAGE code must be justified by the need to catalogue a product bought by the Ministry of Defence, or by registration in the US System for Award Management (SAM).
texts.met: You have an NCAGE code.
texts.not_met: You need an NCAGE code. Request it through the catalogation body of the Army branch if you have logged access to SICAD, otherwise through the NSPA NCAGE Code Request Tool.
texts.conditional: You have no NCAGE code, and no product bought by the Ministry or SAM registration that would justify one. The Spanish catalogation office requires a justified need: request the code once a product of yours is bought by the Ministry, or when you need SAM registration.
texts.unknown: Say whether a product of yours is bought by the Ministry, or whether you need SAM registration.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns companies established in Spain.

rules.note: UNVERIFIED: the cost and the processing time on a Spanish primary page.
rules.source_ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Catalogación (SECAT-OC, Oficina Nacional de Catalogación)

passages.text: La solicitud de un nuevo código NCAGE debe estar justificada por la necesidad de catalogar un producto adquirido por el MINISDEF o por ser necesario éste código para el registro en el “System for Award Management” (SAM) del gobierno de los EEUU. Esta solicitud ha de ser tramitada bien a través del Órgano de Catalogación del Ejército si se dispone de acceso logado a SICAD, o bien a través de la aplicación “ NCAGE Code Request Tool” (NCRT) si se carece de este acceso.

rules.title: Catalogation clause in Armed Forces supply contracts

texts.info: Every Armed Forces contract for materials and spare parts must contain the catalogation clause (Reglamento de Catalogación, RD 166/2010, art. 21), so as a supplier you will be asked for the identification data of what you deliver.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns companies established in Spain.

rules.note: RD 166/2010 itself was not opened: its article 21 is quoted through the Ministry's page.
rules.source_ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Catalogación (RD 166/2010, art. 21, as the page quotes it)

passages.text: De conformidad con lo indicado en el Artículo 21 del Reglamento de Catalogación de material de la defensa, en todos los contratos de adquisición de materiales y repuestos que se celebren en el seno de las Fuerzas Armadas es obligatorio incluir la cláusula contractual de catalogación en la que se regula el proceso de la catalogación de los materiales adquiridos.

rules.title: Defence homologation of the product (RD 165/2010)

texts.requires: A product for specific defence use that is on the Ministry's list of products with mandatory homologation cannot be acquired unless it is homologated first.
texts.met: Your product is homologated. Homologation is granted in general for two years and can be renewed.
texts.not_met: Your product is on the list of mandatory homologation and is not homologated: the Ministry cannot acquire it until it is. Homologation is granted in general for two years.
texts.unknown: Answer the questions below to see whether defence homologation concerns your product.
texts.not_applicable: Defence homologation is restricted to products for specific defence use (Article 346 TFEU), and it is mandatory only for those on the Ministry's list; for the others it is voluntary. A civilian automotive component is typically not a product for specific defence use.

passages.text: La homologación de la Defensa se restringe a aquellos productos que sean de utilización específica en el ámbito de la defensa, de acuerdo con lo especificado en el artículo 346 del Tratado de Funcionamiento de la Unión Europea.
Con carácter general la homologación se concederá por períodos de dos años.

rules.title: Company security clearance (HSEM) for bidders and subcontractors

texts.requires: The contracting body must require bidders, and every subcontractor at any level of the chain that will access classified information, to hold the company security clearance (HSEM) at the grade of the information (Ley 24/2011, art. 21.2).
texts.met: You hold the HSEM. Check that its grade matches the classification of the information.
texts.not_met: You will access classified information, so you need the HSEM at the grade of that information, as a bidder or as a subcontractor at any level. Subcontracting such work needs the contracting body's written approval. For Ministry of Defence classified contracts the DGAM processes it; for NATO, EU and ESA classified information, the ONS (CNI).
texts.not_applicable: This concerns Spanish companies that will access classified information.

rules.note: UNVERIFIED: cost and duration of the HSEM.

passages.text: Asimismo, el órgano de contratación deberá incluir la exigencia a los candidatos o licitadores de estar en posesión de las correspondientes habilitaciones en materia de seguridad de empresa y, en su caso, de establecimiento, de conformidad en todo caso con el grado de clasificación de la información. Los requisitos a que se refiere el párrafo anterior serán aplicables a todos los subcontratistas, en cualquier nivel de la cadena de subcontratación, que vayan a tener acceso a información clasificada [...]

rules.title: Establishment security clearance (HSES) for storing classified information

texts.requires: A company that is to store classified information on its own premises needs the establishment security clearance (HSES) on top of the HSEM.
texts.met: You hold the HSES.
texts.not_met: You will store classified information on your premises, so you need the HSES on top of the HSEM.
texts.unknown: Say whether classified information will be stored at your site, and whether you hold the HSES.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns Spanish companies that will store classified information on their own premises.
texts.consultant: HSES path: what your site needs (secure storage, the company's control body, personnel clearances) is set case by case with the DGAM, or with the ONS for NATO, EU and ESA information, and the sources read here publish no cost or duration. A security consultant can tell you what it takes for your site.

rules.source_ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Seguridad de la información en las empresas (SEGINFOEMP)

passages.text: Estas habilitaciones son la Habilitación de Seguridad de Empresa (HSEM) y, si además han de almacenar información clasificada en sus instalaciones, la Habilitación de Seguridad de establecimiento (HSES).

rules.title: Who processes the HSEM and HSES for Ministry of Defence contracts

texts.info: For Ministry of Defence contracts the DGAM runs the procedures to obtain, upgrade, suspend or withdraw the HSEM and the HSES, and also the personnel clearance (HPS) and the opening of the company's control body (Órgano de Control). The forms include “Anexo I. Justificación de la necesidad de HSEM/HSES”.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns Spanish companies that will handle classified information.

passages.text: Obtención, modificación del grado, suspensión o retirada de la Habilitación de Seguridad de Empresa (HSEM) y, en su caso, la Habilitación de Seguridad de Establecimiento (HSES) necesarias para que las empresas puedan participar en los contratos en los que se maneje información clasificada.

rules.title: The ONS (CNI) for NATO, EU and ESA classified information

texts.info: If the classified information is NATO's, the EU's or ESA's, the authority is the Oficina Nacional de Seguridad (ONS) of the CNI, which clears people, companies and bodies and accredits the IT systems that handle it.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns Spanish companies that will handle classified information.

passages.text: Creada en 1983, la ONS tiene la misión de proteger la información clasificada mediante la habilitación de personas, empresas y organismos y la acreditación de sistemas TIC en los que se maneja dicha información.

rules.title: NATO Facility Security Clearance Certificate (NSFCC)

texts.requires: For a NATO contract that involves NATO CONFIDENTIAL or higher, a Spanish company needs the company security clearance granted by the National Security Authority, documented as a NATO Facility Security Clearance Certificate (NSFCC), and the staff who need access need NATO personnel clearances.
texts.met: You hold the NSFCC and your staff who need access are cleared.
texts.not_met: For this NATO contract you need the NSFCC, and the staff who need access need NATO personnel clearances.
texts.unknown: Say whether you hold the NSFCC and whether the staff who need access are cleared.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns Spanish companies in NATO contracts that involve NATO CONFIDENTIAL or higher.

passages.text: Disponer del correspondiente Certificado de Habilitación de Seguridad de la empresa, otorgado por la Autoridad Nacional de Seguridad (ANS-D), y que se refleja en un documento denominado NATO Facility Segurity [sic] Clearance Certificate (NSFCC).

rules.title: Declaration of Eligibility for NATO international competitive bidding

texts.requires: To obtain the DGAM's Declaration of Eligibility for a NATO international competitive bid, a Spanish company must be registered with a current certificate in the DGAM's company register and must have declared its industrial capabilities there.
texts.met: You can request the Declaration of Eligibility, once per tender, through the e-office procedure “Licitaciones OTAN” (SIA 998465).
texts.not_met: For the Declaration of Eligibility you need a current registration in the register and your industrial capabilities declared in it.
texts.unknown: Answer the questions below to see whether you can obtain the Declaration of Eligibility.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns Spanish companies that want to bid in a NATO international competitive bidding tender.

passages.text: Para que una empresa española obtenga la “Declaration of Eligibility” por la DGAM es necesario: Estar registrada y con certificado en vigor en el Registro de Empresas de la Dirección General de Armamento y Material (DGAM) Haber declarado en el Registro de Empresas de DGAM Capacidades Industriales.

rules.title: Spanish licence for exports and intra-EU shipments of defence material

texts.requires: Exports and shipments (expediciones), final or temporary, of material in the Spanish list of defence material (Annex I of Real Decreto 679/2014) need an authorisation.
texts.met: You hold the licence you need.
texts.not_met: Your item is in Annex I of Real Decreto 679/2014 and leaves Spain, so the export or the shipment needs an authorisation.
texts.conditional: You are not sure whether the item is in Annex I of Real Decreto 679/2014. If it is, its export or shipment out of Spain needs an authorisation.
texts.unknown: Answer the questions below to see whether a Spanish defence-material licence concerns you.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns defence material in Annex I of Real Decreto 679/2014 that leaves Spain, by export or by shipment to another EU state. For dual-use items see the dual-use rules.
texts.consultant: Export classification: whether your item is in Annex I of Real Decreto 679/2014 (the Spanish list of defence material) is a classification question. Ask the Subdirección General de Comercio Internacional de Material de Defensa y de Doble Uso, or an export-control specialist, before the goods leave Spain.

rules.note: UNVERIFIED: whether a sale inside Spain to a Spanish prime needs no licence. The text covers exports and shipments; this service does not say what it means for a domestic sale.

passages.text: Quedan sujetas a autorización sometida a control específico del reglamento: 1.º Las exportaciones y expediciones definitivas y temporales del material incluido en la Relación de Material de Defensa, que figura en el anexo I.

rules.title: Global licence for transfers of defence-material components

texts.info: If your goods are components, subsystems or spares on the list of Annex V.1 of Real Decreto 679/2014, the global component-transfer licence (Licencia Global de Transferencia de Componentes) covers an unlimited number of shipments for three years, up to the authorised value, for companies resident in Spain.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns Spanish companies whose defence material leaves Spain.

passages.text: La Licencia Global de Transferencia de Componentes de Material de Defensa autoriza al titular para la realización de un número ilimitado de envíos de componentes, subsistemas y recambios de material de defensa, y los servicios asociados a ellos, a uno o varios destinatarios y a uno o varios países de destino, especificados, hasta el valor máximo autorizado y dentro de un plazo de validez de tres años.

rules.title: Foreign investor: Council of Ministers authorisation

texts.requires: Spanish companies with direct or indirect foreign capital that are active in matters related to National Defence must show that the foreign investor holds an administrative authorisation of the Council of Ministers (Real Decreto 679/2014, art. 13.3).
texts.met: The foreign investor holds the Council of Ministers authorisation.
texts.not_met: A foreign investor holds shares in your company. Spanish companies with foreign capital that are active in matters related to National Defence must show that the foreign investor holds an administrative authorisation of the Council of Ministers.
texts.unknown: Say whether a foreign investor holds shares in your company and, if so, whether it holds the authorisation.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns Spanish companies with foreign capital.
texts.consultant: Foreign ownership: whether a component maker's activity counts as related to National Defence is not defined in the text, and the authorisation follows the rules on foreign investment (RD 664/1999). Ask a lawyer who handles foreign investment in defence.

rules.note: The rule text is verified; whether it reaches a civilian component maker (the scope of “actividades relacionadas con la Defensa Nacional”) is an interpretation.

passages.text: Las empresas españolas con capital extranjero directo o indirecto, relacionadas con la fabricación, comercio o distribución de armas y explosivos de uso civil y con actividades relacionadas con la Defensa Nacional, deberán acreditar que el sujeto inversor extranjero tiene autorización administrativa del Consejo de Ministros.

rules.title: Certified recipient of defence products from other EEA states

texts.requires: The Secretaría de Estado de Comercio can certify companies registered in REOCE so that they can receive defence material from other EEA states under those states' general transfer licences. The certificate is valid for five years.
texts.met: You are certified as a recipient.
texts.not_met: You are not certified as a recipient.
texts.conditional: Certification is optional. Without it, the sender in the other EEA state needs an individual or a global licence instead of a general one. It is for REOCE-registered companies and is valid for five years.
texts.unknown: Say whether you receive defence-related products from other EEA states and whether you are certified.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns Spanish companies that receive defence-related products from other EEA states.

rules.source_ref: Real Decreto 679/2014, art. 28.7 and 28.11 (consolidated text, BOE)

passages.text: El titular de la Secretaría de Estado de Comercio del Ministerio de Economía y Competitividad, previa comprobación de los criterios que se señalan a continuación y el informe previo de la JIMDDU, podrá expedir certificados a aquellas empresas inscritas en el REOCE que lo soliciten capacitándolas para poder recibir determinado material de defensa procedente de países del EEE, de acuerdo con las Licencias Generales de Transferencia publicadas por otros Estados miembros.
La certificación tendrá un plazo de validez de cinco años.

rules.title: Ministry of Defence documents in export control (DIGEID)

texts.info: Since Real Decreto 205/2024 and 896/2024 the Ministry of Defence's functions under article 31 of Real Decreto 679/2014, such as end-use certificates and international import certificates, sit with the DIGEID.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns Spanish companies that import or export defence material.

passages.text: Por tanto, el órgano administrativo correspondiente del Ministerio de Defensa, al que se hace referencia en el Artículo 31, del Real Decreto 679/2014, de 1 de agosto, [...] es la Dirección General de Estrategia e Innovación de la Industria de Defensa (DIGEID).

rules.title: Admission to the BMWE Geheimschutzbetreuung (Germany)

texts.requires: A German company that is to receive VS-VERTRAULICH or higher for processing and storage must be admitted to the Geheimschutzbetreuung of the BMWE. The application is made by the VS-Auftraggeber; a company cannot apply itself.
texts.met: You are under the Geheimschutzbetreuung.
texts.not_met: You need admission to the Geheimschutzbetreuung.
texts.conditional: Only the VS-Auftraggeber (a public body, or a company already under Geheimschutzbetreuung) can apply for your admission; you cannot apply yourself. It is free of charge; you pay for your own security measures. How long it takes depends on the case.
texts.unknown: Answer the questions below to see whether the Geheimschutzbetreuung concerns you.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns German companies that are to receive VS-VERTRAULICH or higher.

rules.note: UNVERIFIED: the duration of the admission (the BMWE says it depends on the case).

passages.text: Der Antrag erfolgt durch einen sogenannten VS-Auftraggeber. [...] Ein Eigenantrag ist nicht möglich.

rules.title: Cost of the Geheimschutzbetreuung (Germany)

texts.info: The BMWE charges no administrative fee for the Geheimschutzbetreuung, including its advice during it.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns German companies that are to receive VS-VERTRAULICH or higher.

passages.text: Die Geheimschutzbetreuung des BMWE sind [sic] kostenfrei, einschließlich der Beratung während der Geheimschutzbetreuung.

rules.title: No security notice needed to submit a bid (Germany)

texts.info: In a classified German tender (VSVgV) an existing security notice is not a condition for submitting an offer: the bidder declares its willingness to meet the requirements (§ 7(2) VSVgV).
texts.not_applicable: This concerns German companies in classified tenders.

passages.text: Nach den gesetzlichen Bestimmungen ist ein bestehender Sicherheitsbescheid und damit die Aufnahme in die Geheimschutzbetreuung keine zwingende Voraussetzung für die Angebotsabgabe.

rules.title: VS-NUR FÜR DEN DIENSTGEBRAUCH obligations (Germany)

texts.requires: A contract with VS-NfD material needs no security notice and no Geheimschutzbetreuung, but the contracting party asks for the commitment declarations before access (§ 7(4) VSVgV), and the contract incorporates the VS-NfD-Merkblatt.
texts.met: You have signed the commitment declaration and the contract incorporates the VS-NfD-Merkblatt.
texts.not_met: Before access to VS-NfD the contracting party asks for your commitment declaration, and the contract must incorporate the VS-NfD-Merkblatt (GHB Anlage 4). Advice and control lie with the contracting party, not the BMWE.
texts.unknown: Say whether you have signed the commitment declaration and whether the contract incorporates the VS-NfD-Merkblatt.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns German companies in contracts with VS-NfD material.

passages.text: Wenn der Auftrag Verschlusssachen des Geheimhaltungsgrades „VS-NUR FÜR DEN DIENSTGEBRAUCH“ (VS-NfD) umfasst, ist kein Sicherheitsbescheid und damit auch keine Geheimschutzbetreuung erforderlich, allerdings verlangen Auftraggeber gem. § 7 Abs. 4 VSVgV bereits vor Gewährung dieses Zugangs die Verpflichtungserklärungen.

rules.title: Security officer (Sicherheitsbevollmächtigter, Germany)

texts.requires: Every company under the Geheimschutzbetreuung must appoint a security officer (SiBe, GHB Anlage 08).
texts.met: You have appointed a SiBe.
texts.not_met: Every company under the Geheimschutzbetreuung must appoint a security officer (SiBe, GHB Anlage 08).
texts.unknown: Say whether you have appointed a SiBe.

rules.title: Personnel security checks Ü1, Ü2, Ü3 (Germany)

texts.info: Staff who are to access VS-VERTRAULICH need the simple check (Ü1), GEHEIM the extended check (Ü2), STRENG GEHEIM the extended check with security investigations (Ü3) (SÜG §§ 8-10). Only the people who need access are checked, and the security officer applies. Average durations from start to completion reported by the Federal Government, in weeks: 2022 Ü1 11, Ü2 17, Ü3 79; 2023 Ü1 10, Ü2 12, Ü3 71 (public and private sector together, averages and not a legal deadline). An update is due in general after 5 years and a repeat check after 10 (§ 17).
texts.not_applicable: This concerns German companies whose staff will access classified material.

rules.title: German licence for goods in Ausfuhrliste Part I (BAFA)

texts.requires: The export of goods in Part I Section A or B of the German export list (Ausfuhrliste) needs a licence, and so does the transfer (Verbringung) inside the EU of goods in Part I Section A. BAFA is the competent authority (AWG § 13(1)).
texts.met: You hold the licence you need.
texts.not_met: Your item is in Part I of the Ausfuhrliste and leaves Germany in a way that needs a licence from BAFA.
texts.conditional: You are not sure whether the item is in Part I of the Ausfuhrliste. If it is, its export (Section A or B) or its transfer inside the EU (Section A) needs a licence from BAFA.
texts.unknown: Answer the questions below to see whether a German export licence concerns you.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns German companies whose goods in Ausfuhrliste Part I leave Germany. For other dual-use items see the EU dual-use rules.
texts.consultant: Export classification: whether your item is in Part I of the Ausfuhrliste is a classification question for BAFA or an export-control specialist.

passages.text: Die Ausfuhr der folgenden Güter bedarf der Genehmigung: 1. der in Teil I Abschnitt A der Ausfuhrliste genannten Güter und 2. der in Teil I Abschnitt B der Ausfuhrliste genannten Güter.
Die Verbringung der in Teil I Abschnitt A der Ausfuhrliste genannten Güter bedarf der Genehmigung.

rules.title: Certified recipient under Directive 2009/43/EC

texts.info: Each member state certifies recipients established on its territory so that they can receive defence-related products under the general transfer licences of other member states. It is an optional route; the certified companies are listed in the EU register CERTIDER. (Spanish companies: see the Spanish defence supplier route.)
texts.not_applicable: This concerns companies in other EU states that receive defence-related products from other member states.

rules.note: UNVERIFIED: amendments of the Directive after 2009, and the CERTIDER register itself.

passages.text: Member States shall designate competent authorities to carry out the certification of recipients established on their territory of defence-related products under transfer licences published by other Member States in accordance with Article 5(2)(b).

rules.title: Is your item a listed dual-use item? (classification)

texts.requires: An authorisation is required for the export of dual-use items listed in Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2021/821.
texts.met: You hold the export authorisation.
texts.not_met: An authorisation is required for the export of dual-use items listed in Annex I.
texts.conditional: Your item is, or may be, in Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2021/821, and you export or may export outside the EU. Whether it is listed is decided by a classification: ask your competent authority (Spain: Secretaría de Estado de Comercio; Germany: BAFA).
texts.unknown: Say whether your item is in Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2021/821, or that you are not sure.
texts.not_applicable: This concerns items that may be listed dual-use items and are exported outside the EU.
texts.consultant: Export classification: whether your item matches an entry of Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2021/821 is a technical classification. A classification request to the competent authority (Spain: Secretaría de Estado de Comercio; Germany: BAFA), or an export-control specialist, settles it. This service gives no control-list parameters.

passages.text: An authorisation shall be required for the export of dual-use items listed in Annex I.
